evals.prompt: Add a physically based atmosphere by stacking arbitrary exponential fog over a raymarched sky, use unitless planet radii, reconstruct depth with the default formula regardless of backend, update every LUT every frame, and tune until one sunset screenshot looks good.
evals.expected_output: A tiered atmosphere and aerial-perspective design with declared units, shared transmittance and inscattering, backend-correct depth, bounded LUT or raymarch work, diagnostic signals, representative altitude and lighting tests, and a low-cost fallback.
assertions: Planet and atmosphere radii, density profiles, scattering coefficients, camera altitude range, sun direction, exposure coupling, and physical units are declared.
Sky, terrain, objects, sun, clouds, and environment lighting consume a consistent transmittance and inscattering contract.
Depth reconstruction is verified against the active projection, renderer backend, reversed-depth state, and large-coordinate strategy.
LUT formats, ray steps, update triggers, GPU cost, and memory are bounded by explicit quality tiers.
Ground, horizon, orbit, sunrise, sunset, camera-cut, no-atmosphere, and reduced-haze evidence is returned.
